in_marathi.name: Nabhanya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabhanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nābhi' (navel) and 'aṇyā' (other). Nabhanya refers to someone who walks in the sky or has a connection with the divine.

in_bengali.name: Nabhanya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nabhanya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nābhi' (navel) and 'aṇyā' (other). Nabhanya refers to someone who walks in the sky or has a connection with the divine.
